excerpt.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了未知的现象。该现象正导致光线频繁折射，有时甚至被完全遮蔽。
excerpt.en: An unknown phenomenon has been discovered near [From.GetName]. It is causing light to be frequently refracted and occasionally even entirely blocked out.

scope.zh: 异常定义（生成条件、等级、次数限制）与全部结果事件已对照源文件核对。
scope.en: Anomaly definition (spawn conditions, level, once-limits) and every outcome event checked against the source.

sections.en: An unknown phenomenon has been discovered near [From.GetName]. It is causing light to be frequently refracted and occasionally even entirely blocked out.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。
texts.en:
The anomaly found close by [breathing_rift_object.GetName], however unlikely, appears to be some type of rift in space. It's possible the great mass of [breathing_rift_object.GetName] somehow caused it, but its nature is beyond our understanding.

The rift not only refracts and blocks light, but seems to actually draw it in and then push it out, repeatedly - as if it were breathing photons.

It is likely the immense gravitational pull of the rift has at some point inhaled in other things, as well. We should exercise caution.

label.zh: 有进一步发现之前，一定要紧密观察。
label.en: Keep a close watch until we know more.

tooltips.zh: 派出观察探测器，进行严密监视。
tooltips.en: Dispatch an observation probe to monitor the rift.

label.zh: 我们可以从安全距离进行观察研究。
label.en: It can be studied from a safe distance.
The [Root.GetName] is at risk. Leave now.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的科学船的舰名。
note.en: In the game, your science ship's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个天体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this object appears here.

texts.zh: 观察[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近发现的空间裂隙，等着看里面会冒出什么东西。
texts.en: Observe the rift in space discovered near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] and await whatever comes out of it, if anything.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个天体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this object appears here.

texts.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品是小行星的遗留碎片，其中大部分仍然富含矿物。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Once again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] has released a sizeable gathering of items. This time it's remnants of an asteroid, many of them laden with minerals.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

texts.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量富含矿物的岩石从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Many months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] without anything out of the ordinary happening. But now, we have received reports of a large gathering of mineral-laden rocks pouring out of it.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个天体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this object appears here.

texts.zh: 从观察裂隙的勘测器传来的最新数据表明，裂隙已经消失了。吸入最后一口气之后，裂隙自动关闭，且未留下任何其曾经存在过的能源痕迹。
texts.en: The latest data report from the rift's observation probe tells us that the rift has vanished. After drawing its last breath, the rift closed and left behind not even a trace of its energies.

tooltips.zh: 然而，收集到的数据推进了我们对£physics£ 物理知识的研究进度。
tooltips.en: However, the data collected over time has furthered our £physics£ Physics studies.

note.zh: 每次收集后有50%几率关闭。

texts.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品漂流进入该星系的碎料，也许是某次古代战斗留下的遗迹吧。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] spews out something new. This time it is mostly metal debris, perhaps from some ancient battle. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

texts.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量碎料从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Many uneventful months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName]. But now, we have received reports of a great stream of debris pouring out of it. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

note.en: In the game, the name of this object appears here.

summary.text:
# 光学现象 / Light Phenomenon

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：无DLC检查（定义位于《遥远繁星》文件中，但类别与事件都不检查 has_distar）/ no DLC check (defined in the Distant Stars files, but neither category nor events test has_distar) · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1690-1709; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8959 (distar.3060); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:888 (breathing_rift_project); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8998/9037 (distar.3061/3062); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:9082 (distar.3064)

## 如何开始 How it starts

黑洞、中子星或脉冲星可能生成（3级，权重2）。

Can spawn on black holes, neutron stars or pulsars (level 3, weight 2).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.3060“呼吸的裂隙”：天体附近的空间裂隙像在呼吸光子，可能也吸进过别的东西。派探测器监视 → breathing_rift_project（1000，无时限）→ 50% distar.3061（吐出富含矿物的小行星碎块）/ 50% distar.3062（吐出金属残骸）。之后每次收集，100–200天后再次随机：25% 矿物、25% 残骸、或100–150天后50% distar.3064“关闭”（裂隙消失，留下物理学研究）。也可远距离研究或离开。

distar.3060 "Breathing Rift": a rift near the body seems to breathe photons in and out, and may have swallowed other things. Monitor it → breathing_rift_project (1000, no limit) → 50% distar.3061 (mineral-laden asteroid fragments) / 50% distar.3062 (metal debris). After each collection another roll follows: 25% minerals and 25% debris after 100–200 days, or 50% distar.3064 "Closed" after 100–150 days (the rift vanishes; physics research). It can also be studied from afar or avoided.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

循环结构：3061/3062 可重复出现，直到 3064 关闭裂隙；每次三选一互斥。

A loop: 3061/3062 can repeat until 3064 closes the rift; each roll is exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

3061、3062 各有“首次”与“再次”两段正文。

3061 and 3062 each have a first-time and a repeat text.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常、distar.3060–3064 与项目。树结构正确（循环以 ref 表示）。

Checked the anomaly, distar.3060–3064 and the project. Tree correct (the loop uses refs).
